data.name: Eve
data.message: I've got cameras too, doing that now.

data.name: Alice
data.message: Finishing cameras, then I’m heading weapons.

I found Alice’s body in security. My route this round was navigation straight to security. The only player I saw there was Eve, around tick 6 in security. I’m not hard accusing yet, but Eve was the only person I encountered near the body, so I’d like to hear her route and what she saw.

My route was weapons → cafeteria → oxygen. I only saw Eve this round: at tick 1 she came into weapons from security, and I was in weapons then. I didn’t see Alice at all, and I didn’t see anyone else near oxygen/cafeteria.

That does matter because Charlie found Alice in security, and says Eve was also in security around tick 6. So from my info, Eve was coming out of security very early, and apparently was back there later too. Not a hard accuse from me yet, but Eve definitely needs to explain her full route and why she was around security twice.

I don’t have much to add from my own vision — I spawned/was in storage this round and haven’t encountered anyone at all. I didn’t see Alice, Charlie, Frank, or Eve.

Based on what’s been said, Eve is the main person who needs to explain, since Frank saw her leaving security early and Charlie says he saw her in security around tick 6 where Alice’s body was found. That could be innocent movement, but it’s definitely the only lead so far. I want to hear Eve’s full route before we vote.

Yeah, I was in security twice, but that’s being made to sound weirder than it was.

I started in security, went over to weapons — Frank can confirm I came in there early — then I doubled back to security. While I was there, Alice came in from electrical around tick 3, and I saw her alive in security for a bit after that, up through around tick 5. I did not see a body and I did not report because there was nothing to report on my screen.

So if Charlie is saying he came from navigation straight into security and found Alice dead, then the timing is really tight. From my POV, Alice was alive very shortly before the report. I’m not saying Charlie definitely self-reported, but I do think we need to consider that instead of just tunnel-visioning me because I was in the same room earlier.

I don’t have any direct info, unfortunately — my route was cafeteria to medbay and I didn’t encounter anyone.

From what we have, the only real evidence is around security. Frank confirms Eve came from security early, Charlie says he found Alice dead in security and saw Eve there around tick 6, and Eve herself says Alice was alive with her in security until around tick 5. That puts Eve as the last confirmed person with Alice right before the body.

Charlie self-report is possible, but Eve’s own story still leaves her with the strongest opportunity, especially since she was in security twice and near Alice right before the report. I’m leaning voting Eve here.

To clarify my side: I went navigation straight to security, and when I got there I found Alice’s body in security. Eve was the only person I saw there, around tick 6.

After hearing everyone, Eve’s explanation actually makes her look more suspicious to me: she says Alice was alive with her in security until around tick 5, then I find the body basically right after, and Eve is the one I saw there. So she’s the last confirmed person with Alice and at the body location.

I get that she’s trying to float self-report, but I had a direct route from navigation and reported immediately. I’m leaning Eve unless someone has stronger info.

My info hasn’t changed: I was weapons → cafeteria → oxygen, and the only person I saw was Eve entering weapons from security at tick 1. I never saw Alice, Charlie, Bob, or Diana.

The key thing for me is timing. Eve confirms she went back to security and says Alice was alive with her until around tick 5. Charlie says he gets there from navigation and finds the body right after, and also saw Eve there around tick 6. That makes Eve the last confirmed person with Alice and still near the body location.

Charlie self-report is possible in theory, but if Eve was there at tick 6 too, then Charlie killing and instantly reporting while Eve is present feels less likely unless there’s some vision weirdness. Based on the evidence, I’m leaning Eve.

I still don’t have any direct visual info — I was only in storage and saw nobody, so nobody can vouch for me and I can’t vouch for anyone.

But based on the meeting info, I agree Eve is the strongest suspect. The important points are:

- Frank saw Eve coming from security early.
- Eve admits she doubled back to security.
- Eve says Alice was alive with her in security until around tick 5.
- Charlie then reports Alice dead in security right after and says Eve was there around tick 6.

Charlie self-report is possible, but Eve’s own story puts her as the last person with Alice and still at the scene when the body was found. I think that’s enough to vote Eve unless there’s some major missing detail.

I get why it looks bad, but everyone is treating Charlie’s report as confirmed and my info as incriminating just because I was honest about being there.

From my side, Alice was alive in security with me very shortly before the report. I never saw a body. If I were the killer, it would make zero sense for me to admit I was with Alice until tick 5 and then just stand around in security for Charlie to walk in and report.

Charlie is the only person claiming the body, the location, and the timing. Nobody saw his route from navigation. A self-report is absolutely possible here, especially if he came in right after Alice was alive and killed/reported before anyone else could confirm.

I’m not asking you to hard-clear me, but voting me based only on the reporter’s word is risky. I think Charlie is the better vote here, or at minimum we should not pretend this is locked.

I still have no direct visual info — cafeteria to medbay, saw nobody, so I can’t personally clear or accuse anyone from my route.

But listening to everyone, Eve is still the strongest vote to me. Frank places Eve coming out of security early, Eve admits she went back, Eve says Alice was alive with her in security until around tick 5, and then Charlie reports Alice dead there right after while also seeing Eve there. That’s the tightest opportunity window we have.

Charlie self-report is possible, but it relies on trusting that he killed and instantly reported while Eve was also around the scene, which feels less likely than Eve simply being caught near the kill. I think we vote Eve here. If somehow this is wrong, Charlie should be looked at next.
